correctness.rationale: For any factors, testing all fiber-constant lift modes bounds λ2 by α_i B_i/(N/n_i), and separable factor optimizers attain every bound at equalized spectral gaps. For grids, centered coordinate vectors yield the sharp exact budget upper bound. The weighted path polynomial flag gives the full spectrum; saturation makes each coordinate vector an eigenvector and a fiberwise first-order recurrence forces all edge weights uniquely. Exact and numerical checks of eight grid shapes and 1440 nonsymmetric competitors agree; no finite test substitutes for the proof.
